title: Explicit type conversion (casting) and static_cast
recap: static_cast requests an explicit conversion between compatible types. It makes an intentional numeric change visible but does not perform range validation for you.
Apply the cast before the operation that needs the wider type. A cast around an integer-division expression happens too late to preserve its fraction.
objectives: Implement the stated behavior for multiple inputs.
Practice explicit type conversion (casting) and static_cast.
Run the visible tests and explain one boundary case.
warnings: The function/type interface is fixed, but implementation syntax is your choice.
Do not remove the visible tests; the checker keeps an independent copy.
Respect the stated input domain and lifetime/range rules.
challenge: Implement successRate(successes, attempts) as a percentage in [0,100]. Return -1.0 when attempts <= 0, successes < 0, or successes > attempts. Preserve fractional percentages. Counts are at most 100000.
hints: Validate all three invalid conditions before dividing.
Convert successes to double before division.
Multiply the fraction by 100 to obtain a percentage.
